title: InventoryReleased
description: Topic: inventory.released. Producer: inventory. Consumer(s): orders. Published after a ReleaseStock call completes (the saga's compensation path) — see contracts/proto/inventory.proto. Carries what was released, not why: the reason a release was triggered (e.g. a failed payment) lives on PaymentFailed, which is what caused orders to ask for the release in the first place.
